titulo: The police sat right above the body 😨 Part 2 #horror #shorts
descripcion:
He hid the old man under the floor. Then the police came, and he sat right above the spot.

Was he mad, or did the dead man's heart really beat?

Based on "The Tell-Tale Heart" by Edgar Allan Poe (public domain).
#edgarallanpoe #telltaleheart #horror #classicstories #shorts

lineas.texto: The old man was dead. Stone dead. His eye would trouble me no more.
I took up three planks from the floor, and placed him beneath.
At four in the morning, someone knocked. Police. A neighbor had heard a shriek.
I smiled. I had nothing to fear. I led them into his very room.
And I set my chair right over the spot where he lay.
Then I heard it. A low, dull, quick sound.
Louder. Louder. Could they not hear it? They were mocking me.
I screamed. Tear up the planks! Here, here! It is the beating of his hideous heart!
Was he mad? Or did the dead man's heart really beat?
